hook.name: CornersHookDynamicFee
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Corners protocol that implements volatility-based dynamic LP fees (derived from tick movement between swaps) and collects a 20% protocol fee on the paired-token side of each swap. Includes an optional MEV protection module active for the first 2 minutes after pool creation, and restricts liquidity additions during that window.
